---
name: implementation-agent-instructions
description: "Use when implementing features, writing/refactoring code in scope, and adding unit-level tests."
applyTo: ["src/**", "views/**", "**/*.php", "**/*.js", "**/*.css", "**/*.scss"]
---
# Implementation Agent Instruction

- Read related files before editing.
- Avoid broad refactors outside requested scope.
- Keep naming and conventions aligned with existing codebase.
- Add or update unit-level validation where applicable.
- Report executed commands and observed results.
